title: IL-4 drives exhaustion of CD8+ CART cells
model: Healthy-donor CART19-28z cells (3 donors), GeCKO v2 library A
contrast: Day 22 (chronic stimulation) vs day 8, paired by donor (3 vs 3)
paper_calls: CSF2, SOCS1, PTPN2 top positively selected; 2 of 3 IL4 guides enriched
named_hits: 3/4 at FDR 0.10 (PTPN2, SOCS1, CSF2; CSF2 from one jackpot guide); IL4 not called
verdict: BARCS confirms PTPN2 and SOCS1 as knockouts that resist exhaustion, but IL4, the paper's headline gene, is not a screen hit: its guides rise in two donors and fall in the third.
count_recovery: Raw reads = normalized / (one scale factor per sample); integrality 100.0%.
